/* interfaceMapper.selectTrackingHbl 해당 하우스번호 데이터 조회 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO , od.HBL_NO , od.ORIG_CODE , od.DEST_CODE , '한국' AS OrigName , od.VESSEL_FLIGHT , od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS buyernm , od.HBL_NO AS hawbno , (SELECT COUNT(item.OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM item WHERE item.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO) AS itemcnt , od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS rcptnm , CASE odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS WHEN 'ECM030' THEN '발송대기(complete clearance)' WHEN 'ECM060' THEN '항공출발(shipped to air(overseas))' WHEN 'ECM070' THEN '항공도착(arrived in korea)' WHEN 'ECM120' THEN '통관중(customs clearance of korea)' WHEN 'ECM240' THEN '통관완료(complete clearance)' WHEN 'ECM360' THEN '택배집하(receuot to korea post office)' WHEN 'ECM420' THEN '배송완료(clear to delivery)' END AS stepnm , od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC AS rcptaddr , od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE AS zipcode , od.COMMODITY_ITEM AS itemnm , od.PO_NO AS custordno FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL odAdd ON od.OD_JOB_NO = odAdd.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.SOLUTION = 'ECM' AND od.HBL_NO IN(
#{item} ) AND od.BOUND_TYPE = 'IMP'
AND od.BOUND = 'AIR'
AND od.BOUND = 'SEA'

/* interfaceMapper.selectDeliveryTracking 해당 하우스번호로 상태값 정보 각 배송사에 맞게 변환된 데이터 조회 */ SELECT CASE A.DELIVERY_CODE WHEN 'EMS' THEN A.DELIVERY_STORE_NAME WHEN 'KOREX' THEN '대한통운' END AS locationNm ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, A.POD_DATE, 23) + ' ' + A.POD_TIME AS stepDt ,'' AS memo ,CASE A.DELIVERY_CODE WHEN 'EMS' THEN '우체국콜센터(1588-1300)' WHEN 'KOREX' THEN '대한통운콜센터(1588-1255)' END AS csInfo ,CASE A.POD_STATUS WHEN 'ECM003' THEN '집하' WHEN 'ECM010' THEN '발송대기'
WHEN 'ECM060' THEN '항공출발' WHEN 'ECM070' THEN '항공도착'
WHEN 'ECM060' THEN '출발' WHEN 'ECM070' THEN '도착'
WHEN 'ECM120' THEN '통관중' WHEN 'ECM250' THEN '통관중' WHEN 'ECM240' THEN '통관완료' WHEN 'ECM280' THEN '통관완료' WHEN 'ECM360' THEN '집하지시' WHEN 'ECM361' THEN '집하처리' WHEN 'ECM370' THEN '간선상차' WHEN 'ECM380' THEN '간선하차' WHEN 'ECM390' THEN '배송출발' WHEN 'ECM400' THEN '미배달' WHEN 'ECM420' THEN '배송완료' END AS statusNm ,CASE A.POD_STATUS WHEN 'ECM003' THEN '00' WHEN 'ECM010' THEN '10' WHEN 'ECM060' THEN '20' WHEN 'ECM070' THEN '30' WHEN 'ECM120' THEN '40' WHEN 'ECM250' THEN '40' WHEN 'ECM240' THEN '50' WHEN 'ECM280' THEN '50' WHEN 'ECM360' THEN '60' WHEN 'ECM361' THEN '60' WHEN 'ECM370' THEN '61' WHEN 'ECM380' THEN '62' WHEN 'ECM390' THEN '63' WHEN 'ECM400' THEN '68' WHEN 'ECM420' THEN '70' END AS statusCd FROM(
SELECT pod.DELIVERY_STORE_NAME ,pod.POD_DATE ,pod.POD_TIME ,pod.POD_STATUS ,od.DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_POD pod ON pod.OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AND pod.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM070') WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{OD_JOB_NO}
UNION ALL SELECT '' AS DELIVERY_STORE_NAME ,pod.POD_DATE ,pod.POD_TIME ,pod.POD_STATUS ,od.DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_POD_01 pod ON pod.OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AND pod.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM070') WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{OD_JOB_NO}
UNION ALL SELECT pod.DELIVERY_STORE_NAME ,pod.POD_DATE ,pod.POD_TIME ,pod.POD_STATUS ,(SELECT DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO) AS DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_POD pod WHERE pod.OD_JOB_NO = #{OD_JOB_NO} AND pod.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM003','ECM010','ECM120','ECM240','ECM250','ECM280','ECM360','ECM361','ECM370','ECM380','ECM390','ECM400','ECM420')
UNION ALL SELECT '' AS DELIVERY_STORE_NAME ,pod.POD_DATE ,pod.POD_TIME ,pod.POD_STATUS ,(SELECT DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO) AS DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 pod WHERE pod.OD_JOB_NO = #{OD_JOB_NO} AND pod.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM003','ECM010')
UNION ALL SELECT '' AS DELIVERY_STORE_NAME ,pod.POD_DATE ,pod.POD_TIME ,pod.POD_STATUS ,(SELECT DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO) AS DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 pod WHERE pod.OD_JOB_NO = #{OD_JOB_NO} AND pod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM120'
UNION ALL SELECT '' AS DELIVERY_STORE_NAME ,pod.POD_DATE ,pod.POD_TIME ,pod.POD_STATUS ,(SELECT DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO) AS DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_POD_03 pod WHERE pod.OD_JOB_NO = #{OD_JOB_NO} AND pod.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM240','ECM250','ECM280')
UNION ALL SELECT pod.DELIVERY_STORE_NAME ,pod.POD_DATE ,pod.POD_TIME ,pod.POD_STATUS ,(SELECT DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO) AS DELIVERY_CODE FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 pod WHERE pod.OD_JOB_NO = #{OD_JOB_NO} AND pod.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM360','ECM361','ECM370','ECM380','ECM390','ECM400','ECM420') ) A ORDER BY A.POD_DATE, A.POD_TIME

/* interfaceMapper.selectStockAPI 스탁테이블에서 API 타입 스탁 데이터 조회 */ SELECT SEQ_NO , BOUND , BOUND_TYPE , STOCK_TYPE , STOCK_METHOD , START_NO , END_NO , ENT_CODE , ENT_BUSINESS_CODE , AGENT_CODE , CURRENT_NO , TR_CODE , (CASE WHEN TR_CODE IN('KOREX','KOREXMUL','HANJIN') THEN (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),CURRENT_NO),1,11)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),START_NO),1,11)) + 1 END) WHEN TR_CODE IN('EMS-KP','EMS-TS') THEN (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),CURRENT_NO),1,8)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),START_NO),1,8)) + 1 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CURRENT_NO - START_NO + 1 END) END ) AS Used , (CASE WHEN TR_CODE IN('KOREX','KOREXMUL','HANJIN') THEN (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),END_NO),1,11)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),START_NO),1,11)) + 1 ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),END_NO),1,11)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),CURRENT_NO),1,11)) END) WHEN TR_CODE IN('EMS-KP','EMS-TS') THEN (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),END_NO),1,8)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),START_NO),1,8)) + 1 ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),END_NO),1,8)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),CURRENT_NO),1,8)) END) ELSE (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN END_NO - START_NO + 1 ELSE END_NO - CURRENT_NO END) END ) AS unUsed FROM TB_ECM_STOCK WHERE 1 = 1 AND BOUND_TYPE = #{BoundType} AND BOUND = #{Bound}
AND TR_CODE = #{TrCode} AND AGENT_CODE = #{agentCode}
/* interfaceMapper.getCreateStockAPI API 타입 스탁 데이터 생성하는 프로시저 호출 */ EXEC p_CREATE_EXPRESS_STOCK #{Bound}, #{BoundType}, '', #{agentCode}, #{TrCode}, #{HblCnt}, ''
/* interfaceMapper.getCreateEmsStockAPI EMS API 타입 스탁 데이터 생성하는 프로시저 호출 */ EXEC p_CREATE_EXPRESS_STOCK_EMS #{Bound}, #{BoundType}, '', #{agentCode}, #{TrCode}, 1, '';
/* interfaceMapper.checkKorexPostCode 대한통운 DB에서 우편번호로 주소정보 조회 */ SELECT * FROM TB_POST010 WHERE ZIP_NO = REPLACE(#{zipcode} ,'-', '') AND ROWNUM = 1

/* interfaceMapper.getHanjinAddressCode ECM 한진 집배코드 조회 */
SELECT (SELECT HUB_COD FROM VW_HUB_COD WHERE DML_COD = ( SELECT TML_COD FROM VW_ZIP_HJ WHERE ZIP_COD = #{zipcode} ) AND aml_cod = ( SELECT TML_COD FROM VW_ZIP_HJ WHERE ZIP_COD = #{sZipcode}) AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS HUB_COD, a.TML_COD, a.TML_NAM, a.DOM_MID, a.CEN_COD, a.DOM_PDZ, a.CEN_NAM, a.ES_NAM, (SELECT TML_COD FROM VW_ZIP_HJ WHERE ZIP_COD = #{sZipcode}) AS STML_COD, (SELECT TML_NAM FROM VW_ZIP_HJ WHERE ZIP_COD = #{sZipcode}) AS STML_NAM, a.PDZ_NAM, a.DOM_RGN FROM VW_ZIP_HJ a WHERE ZIP_COD = #{zipcode}

/* interfaceMapper.selectOrderRegisterDate */ SELECT TOP 1 od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.BOUND ,od.PIECES
FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.HBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(#{hblNo},char(9),''))) AND od.REGISTER_DATE_TIME BETWEEN DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()) AND DATEADD(MONTH, 1, GETDATE()) ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC

/* interfaceMapper.selectBmsOutPlanRegisterDate */ SELECT TOP 1 OUT_PLAN_NO
FROM TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE BL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{hblNo})) AND REGISTER_DATE_TIME BETWEEN DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()) AND DATEADD(MONTH, 1, GETDATE()) ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC

/* interfaceMapper.updateBmsOutScanDate */ UPDATE TB_BMS_OUT SET OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME = #{scanDate} WHERE BL_NO = #{hblNo} AND OUT_APPROVAL_NO = #{outApprovalNo} AND OUT_CLASS = #{outClass}
mapper.select: /* interfaceMapper.selectOblTracking */ SELECT obl.HBL_NO ,pod.POD_STATUS AS TRACKING_CODE ,CONCAT(pod.POD_DATE, ' ', pod.POD_TIME) AS TRACKING_DATE_TIME ,pod.REMARKS AS TRACKING_REMARK FROM TB_COM_OBL obl INNER JOIN TB_COM_POD pod ON pod.OBL_JOB_NO = obl.OBL_JOB_NO WHERE obl.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND obl.HBL_NO = #{hblNo} AND obl.SOLUTION = 'EMS'
/* interfaceMapper.insertImageDisplayInfo : 동시구현 DB 프로시저 호출 */ EXEC SP_INSERT_XRAY_INTF #{bagId}, #{bagAlias}, #{workStationName}, #{machineName}, #{event}, #{timeStamp}

/* interfaceMapper.selectEmsOrderRequestBl */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SELECT TOP 1 OD.OD_JOB_NO , OD.HBL_NO , OD.PO_NO , OD.PO_DATE , OD.DELIVERY_CODE , AD.EMS_YN , EMS.MAIL_TYPE FROM TB_ECM_OD OD JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL AD ON OD.OD_JOB_NO = AD.OD_JOB_NO JOIN TB_ECM_OD_EMS_INFO EMS ON OD.OD_JOB_NO = EMS.OD_JOB_NO WHERE OD.ENT_CODE = #{ReceiverId} AND OD.PO_NO = #{ordId}

/* interfaceMapper.selectUnusedStockAPI 스탁테이블에서 API 타입 스탁 데이터 카운트 조회 */ SELECT SUM(unUsed) as sumUnUsed from ( SELECT SEQ_NO , BOUND , BOUND_TYPE , STOCK_TYPE , STOCK_METHOD , START_NO , END_NO , ENT_CODE , ENT_BUSINESS_CODE , AGENT_CODE , CURRENT_NO , TR_CODE , (CASE WHEN TR_CODE IN('KOREX','KOREXMUL','HANJIN') THEN (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),CURRENT_NO),1,11)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),START_NO),1,11)) + 1 END) WHEN TR_CODE IN('EMS-KP','EMS-TS') THEN (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),CURRENT_NO),1,8)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),START_NO),1,8)) + 1 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CURRENT_NO - START_NO + 1 END) END ) AS Used , (CASE WHEN TR_CODE IN('KOREX','KOREXMUL','HANJIN') THEN (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),END_NO),1,11)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),START_NO),1,11)) + 1 ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),END_NO),1,11)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(12),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),CURRENT_NO),1,11)) END) WHEN TR_CODE IN('EMS-KP','EMS-TS') THEN (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),END_NO),1,8)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),START_NO),1,8)) + 1 ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),END_NO),1,8)) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(9),SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(18),CURRENT_NO),1,8)) END) ELSE (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_NO, 0) = 0 THEN END_NO - START_NO + 1 ELSE END_NO - CURRENT_NO END) END ) AS unUsed FROM TB_ECM_STOCK WHERE 1 = 1 AND STOCK_USE_YN = 'Y' AND BOUND_TYPE = #{BoundType} AND BOUND = #{Bound}
AND TR_CODE = #{TrCode} AND (AGENT_CODE = #{agentCode} OR AGENT_CODE = #{entCode}) ) stock

/* interfaceMapper.selectEmsOrderRequestBl */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SELECT TOP 1 od.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo , od.ENT_CODE AS entCode , od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE AS entBusinessCode , od.HBL_NO AS deliveryNo , od.PO_NO AS poNo , od.PO_DATE AS poDate , od.DELIVERY_CODE AS deliveryCode , od.MULTI_YN , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO) AS MULTI_CNT , CASE WHEN od.HBL_NO = #{hblNo} THEN 'M' ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND DELIVERY_NO = #{hblNo} ) THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END END AS MULTI_DATA , od.REGISTER_USER_ID AS userId FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{ReceiverId} AND od.PO_NO = #{ordId}
